readme:
# Bazos Classifieds Scraper

Scrape classified ads from [Bazos](https://www.bazos.sk), the largest free classifieds platform in Central Europe. Covers Slovakia (bazos.sk), Czechia (bazos.cz), Austria (bazos.at), and Poland (bazos.pl).

## How it works

1. Open Bazos ([bazos.sk](https://www.bazos.sk), [bazos.cz](https://www.bazos.cz), bazos.at or bazos.pl), set your search, category and filters
2. Paste the result URL(s) into `searchUrls`
3. Run the actor

The actor extracts all listings matching your search, with automatic pagination. The country and currency are detected from the URL. Proxy handling is built in, nothing to configure. With an empty input it returns up to 10 results of the default iPhone search on bazos.sk (demo run).

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client — Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/bazos-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `bazos-scraper` to scrape company data from bazos. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Output

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `title` | Listing title |
| `price` / `currency` | Price in EUR, CZK, or PLN |
| `location` | City / district |
| `postal_code` | Postal code |
| `category` | Listing category |
| `image_url` | Thumbnail image |
| `views` | Number of views |
| `is_top` | Paid TOP (promoted) ad |
| `seller_name` | Seller display name |
| `country` | `sk`, `cz`, `at` or `pl` |
| `description` | Listing text as shown in search results (may be truncated by Bazos) |
| `posted_at` | Publication date |
| `source_url` | Link to listing on Bazos |

## Pricing

Results are charged per listing. Runs that return no results or fail on invalid input are charged only the start fee, never results:

| Event | Cost |
|-------|------|
| Listing | $0.003 |

**100 listings = $0.30** | **1,000 listings = $3.00**

## Examples

### iPhones in Slovakia
```json
{
  "searchUrls": ["https://www.bazos.sk/search.php?hledat=iphone&rubriky=www"],
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Several searches across countries
```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.bazos.cz/search.php?hledat=samsung&rubriky=www",
    "https://www.bazos.pl/search.php?hledat=samsung&rubriky=www"
  ],
  "maxResults": 200
}
```

## Data protection

This actor returns only data that is publicly visible on the source pages. Results can include personal data, such as names, phone numbers, email addresses and addresses of private persons, sole traders or contact persons. Where the source labels an entry type, it is included so you can filter the results yourself.

You are responsible for using the data lawfully, including the GDPR/DSGVO, national data-protection laws and unfair-competition rules (e.g. UWG) for marketing and outreach.

## Issues & Feedback

Missing something or not working as expected? [Open an issue](https://console.apify.com/actors/tBgNfiXUTGXoshNQn/issues) and we'll fix it.
